About

I'm Anushka. A product designer working across mobile, web, and B2B SaaS.

4+ years of practice in research, IA, high-fidelity Figma, and production frontend. Computer engineering background, postgraduate in full-stack development, the pipeline from problem to shipped product is the part of design I care about.

Based in Dallas,TX Originally from Kathmandu, Nepal Open to full-time roles

My story, briefly

From engineering to design to product.

I started in Computer Engineering at Kathmandu Engineering College, expecting to write software, not design it. A UX internship at Leapfrog Technology in 2021 changed that. Watching a small team turn user interviews into shipped flows convinced me design was the part of software I actually wanted to do.

I joined Core Software Integrated shortly after as a UI/UX designer, and spent nearly two years (2021–2023) leading design on consumer and B2B products, including Belly Foods, Chatter, and the LMC Ward 10 survey app. Mobile, web, multi-tenant SaaS, civic tech, the variety taught me how to think about products rather than just screens.

In 2023 I moved to Ontario, Canada, for a postgraduate program in Full Stack Software Development at Lambton College. The goal was deliberate: close the loop between design and code, so my Figma files turn into the React they were meant to be. The design practice never paused, through the program I kept taking product briefs, and I finished in 2025 by designing, building, and shipping a production storefront for Banh Mi & Bites as my co-op. Currently working at Apex Accounting as a Product Designer.
